sandhāya.g: hi imassa vacanassa ayamadhippāyo–“aparikkhitte pamukhe anāpattī”ti yaṁ vuttaṁ, taṁ vinā vatthuṁ bhūmiyaṁ katagehassa pamukhaṁ sandhāya kathitaṁ.

āpannāya pārājikāpattiyā kehicipi samathehi anāpattibhāvāpādanassa asakkuṇeyyattasaṅkhātamatthaṁ sandhāya.
garubhaṇḍena garubhaṇḍaparivattanaṁ sandhāya.
liṅge parivatte paṭiggahaṇassa vijahanato puna appaṭiggahetvā paribhuñjanāpattiṁ sandhāya vuttaṁ.

bhikkhuniyā gāmāpariyāpannaparatīre nadisamīpameva sandhāya vuttā.

sandhāya.l: Sace kho te Jīvaka idaṁ sandhāya bhāsitan
sandhāya.g: Jīvaka mahābrahmunā vikkhambhanappahānena byāpādādayo pahīnā, tena so mettāvihārī mayhaṁ samucchedappahānena, sace te idaṁ sandhāya bhāsitaṁ, evaṁ sante tava idaṁ vacanaṁ anujānāmīti attho.
ye suttapariyosāne “te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṁ abhinandun”ti vuttā pañcasatā brāhmaṇapabbajitā, te sandhāya.
Kattha pana vuttaṁ? Sāmaññaphale.

“mūle sassatan”ti-ādinā vuttapaṭhamaggāhassa samānajātiyaṁ aparaggāhaṁ sandhāya.
byatirekavasena khīṇāsavaṁ sandhāya.
dukkhāya paṭipadāya niyyānataṁ sandhāya.
dhammukhena puggalaggahaṇaṁ sandhāya.
katthacipi tassa dassanaṁ sandhāya, na pariññādassanaṁ.

taṁ sūkarakhataleṇaṁ sandhāya.
taṁ vedanāya ārammaṇabhāvaṁ sandhāya.

sandhāya.l: Idañca pana metaṁ Sāriputta sandhāya bhāsitan
sandhāya.g: Sāriputta mayā pārāyane udayapañhe idaṁ phalasamāpatti meva sandhāya etaṁ bhāsitaṁ.

sandhāya.l: Idañca pana metaṁ bhikkhave sandhāya bhāsitan
sandhāya.g: bhikkhave yaṁ mayā etaṁ puṇṇakapañhe “saṅkhāya lokasmin”ti-ādi bhāsitaṁ, taṁ idaṁ phalasamāpattiṁ sandhāya bhāsitanti attho.

sandhāya.l: No ca kho yaṁ tvaṁ sandhāya vadesī
sandhāya.g: yañca kho tvaṁ sandhāya vadesi, so pariyāyo na hoti.
atthoyeva vā atthavaso, dve atthe dve kāraṇānīti vuttaṁ hoti.
parihānañca aparihānañca sandhāya jātake2 vutaṁ.
imaṁ aturitacārikaṁ sandhāya.
imaṁ yathāvuttaṁ pariyosānappattaṁ manodvārikavedanaṁ sandhāya.

sandhāya.l: Yañca kho tvaṁ sandhāya vadesi, so pariyāyo na hotī
sandhāya.g: yaṁ vandanādisāmaggirasābhāvasaṅkhātaṁ kāraṇaṁ arasarūpatāya vadesi, taṁ kāraṇaṁ na hoti, na vijjatīti attho.
Mukhyāhāravasenapi nerayikānaṁ āhāraṭṭhitikataṁ dassetuṁ “

sandhāya.l: Yaṁ pana javanena -pa- taṁ kusalaṁ sandhāya vuttan
sandhāya.g: idaṁ kusalassa viya akusalassa sadiso vipāko natthīti katvā vuttaṁ.
lokiyadhammānaṁ ayaṁ sabhāvo yadidaṁ te cittajeṭṭhakā cittapubbaṅgamā pavattantīti dasseti.k Tena tesaṁ tathādesanāya kāraṇamāha, sabbe akusalā dhammā cittavajjāti attho.
“saṅkappo kāmo rāgo kāmo”ti1 ettha vuttaṁ saṅkappaṁ sandhāyāti adhippāyo.
“dve dhammā”ti sandhāya.
idaṁ vicāretabbaṁ upekkhāsahagatakusalākusalajavanānantarampi somanassasahagatatadārammaṇassa icchitattā.
“yo saccikaṭṭho”ti ettha vutto yo saccikaṭṭho, sosappaccayādibhāvena dīpito “rūpañca- upalabbhatī”ti-ādīsu āgato dhammappabhedoti dasseti.
nirayūpagassa puggalassa asaññūpagassa arūpūpagassa ca antarābhavaṁ na icchatīti cutito anantaraṁ upapattiṁ sandhāyāti attho daṭṭhabbo.
chekaṭṭhaṁ sandhāya vuttaṁ, na kusalapaññattiṁ.

sandhāya.l: Gihīnañceva ekaccānañca devānaṁ maggapaṭilātaṁ sandhāya paṭikkhepo tassevā
sandhāya.g: vuttaṁ, “yattha natthī”ti pana okāsavasena puṭṭho puggalavasena tassa paṭikkhepo na yutto.
lakkhaṇasamannāgatesu abodhisatte chaḍḍhetvā bodhisattameva gahetvā idaṁ suttaṁ vuttaṁ, na bodhisattato añño lakkhaṇasamannāgato natthīti.
anariyassa etaṁ ñāṇaṁ sandhāyāti adhippāyo siyā.
bhaṅgānupassanānaṁ bhaṅgato anupasanāsantatiṁ sandhāyāti adhippāyo.
samāpattiyā āsannabhāvato tadāpi samāpannoyevāti adhippāyo.
sakasamayalakkhaṇena paṭikkhepo katoti vadanti.
nirodhasamāpannato aññe yesaṁ nirodhasamāpattiyā bhavitabbaṁ, te pañcavokārasatte sandhāyāti adhippāyo, asaññasattānampi ca saññuppādā cutiṁ icchantīti sesasabbasatte sandhāyāti vā.

“cakkhunā rūpaṁ disvā nimittaggāhī hotī”ti-ādinā1 nayena vuttaṁ manoviññāṇapaṭijānanaṁ kira sandhāyāti adhippāyo, tasmā “evaṁ sante rūpaṁ manoviññāṇaṁ āpajjatīti manoviññāṇapaṭijānanaṁ pana rūpadassanaṁ kathaṁ hotī”ti vicāretabbaṁ.

sandhāya.l: Na parijānātīti pañhe puthujjanaṁ sandhāya āmantāti vuttan
sandhāya.g: idaṁ puthujjanassa sabbathā pariññākiccassa abhāvato vuttaṁ.

sandhāya.l: Saghānakānaṁ sacakkhukānanti paripuṇṇāyatanameva opapātikaṁ sandhāya vuttan
sandhāya.g: ettha eva-saddaṁ
idaṁ uppādakkhaṇasamaṅgipacchimacittasamaṅgimhi puggale adhippete tañca cittaṁ adhippetameva hotīti katvā vuttanti daṭṭhabbaṁ.
idaṁ dukamūlake pucchānaṁ mūlabhūtā tevīsati dukā sambhavantīti tassa “tevīsatimūlakan”ti nāmaṁ katvā yāva yattako pabhedo atthi, tāva tattakaṁ tevīsatimūlakaṁ yathānulome vitthāritaṁ.
paṭhanti.
paṭisandhiyaṁ hetunāmapaccayaṁ vatthurūpañca paccayuppannaṁ sandhāya.
“adhimuccanaṁ adhimokkho, so sanniṭṭhānalakkhaṇo”ti dhammasaṅgahavaṇṇanāyaṁ1 “taṇhāpaccayā adhimokkho, adhimokkhapaccayā bhavo”ti paṭiccasamuppādavibhaṅge2 ca āgataṁ vacanaṁ sandhāya.
ekaṁ pabbajjāsaṅkhātaṁ brahmacariyavāsaṁ sandhāya bhaṇitaṁ.
tatiyasaṅgītikāle uppanne vāde sandhāya.
diṭṭhiyā parikappitena sattena suññe saṅkhāre sandhāya “suññatañca manasi karotī”ti pucchāya “āmantā”ti paṭijānantassa.

sandhāya.l: Idha kusalavacanena gahite khandhe sandhāya vuttan
sandhāya.g: imasmiṁ paṭiccavāre “kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjatī”ti kusalasaddena gahite khandhe sandhāya vuttaṁ catūsupi kusalakhandhesu ekato uppajjamānesu sāmaññato vuttesu sahajātādisādhāraṇapaccayavasena avisesato sabbe sabbesaṁ paccayāti ayameva imassa paccayo, imasseva ayaṁ paccayoti ca niyametvā vattuṁ na sakkā.
taṁ evaṁ paṭiladdhaṁ samādhiṁ sandhāya.
taṁ tesaṁ vacanaṁ atītaṁsañāṇaṁ ce, rūpāvacaraṁ adhippetaṁ na yujjati parikammasamādhiñāṇassa kāmāvacarabhāvato.
yaṁ khaṇikamaraṇaṁ sandhāya, “jarāmaraṇaṁ dvīhi khandhehi saṅgahitan”ti2 ettha “maraṇan”ti vuttanti attho.
